summary: Hunter on McAlpin Mountain in North Routt paged shortly after 1 a.m.; had planned to camp but was unprepared for wet/cold conditions and unable to hike to the trailhead; Classic Air flew two RCSAR members to his location and transported the hunter and team off the mountain
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue + Classic Air Medical
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Fall Edition Nov 2023 (org publication); date from dated mission header
